free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixed RNG seed makes the graph, the sampled guidance bins and the z3 search deterministic.

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: One input dimension yields exactly one collected guidance constraint, so the halving loop reaches its empty-list break and the last target decision stays true.

free_parameters.name: default_bins
free_parameters.why: Widens the log2 bins so the sampled single-dimension lower bound (143473) sits between the two integer megabyte_lim limits (131072 and 262144).

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: No operator nodes: the target is about post_process guidance, and the single placeholder already exercises gen_ph_cons guidance deterministically.

free_parameters.name: opset
free_parameters.why: A non-empty opset is required by SimpleGenerator; with max_nodes=0 no operator is ever instantiated or executed.

free_parameters.name: constrain_prob
free_parameters.why: GuidedGen default from NNSMITH_G_PROB is 1.0; keep every collected constraint so the guidance list is non-empty.

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: Small generation budget; with max_nodes=0 the loop performs no generation work, only the fixed post-processing.

execution.entry_reason: random_model_gen (call_chain[0]) constructs PureSymbolGen, whose post_process is the inherited no-op SimpleGenerator.post_process; the target GuidedGen.post_process is never reached under the official entry. The driver instead calls the real call-chain method SimpleGenerator.abstract_gen on a real GuidedGen instance, so the target code executes unmodified; no repository file or class is replaced.
